items.title: Familiarity from rereading vs. recall from teach-back
items.description: An illustrative model, not measured data: drag 'rereads' up and notice felt-familiarity climb fast even while teach-back attempts stay at 0 — recall barely moves. That gap between the two lines is the illusion of competence made visible. Then raise teach-back attempts and watch recall finally catch up.
items.compute: const familiarity = Math.min(97, 100 * (1 - Math.exp(-params.rereadCount / 3))); const recall = Math.min(97, 100 * (1 - Math.exp(-params.teachbackAttempts / 2))); return { familiarity: Math.round(familiarity), recall: Math.round(recall) };
